note: הפועל תל אביב במפעלי אסיה — 1967 (אלופה, גמר בבנגקוק) ו-1970 (סגנית, טהרן). A second reading of the Asian rows already in matches.json, from RSSSF (Enda Mulcahy, updated 4.1.2018) cross-read with Wildstat and Wikipedia on 24.9.2026. It adds only what those sources state: the 1967 final's date, city and ground (raising it from one source to three), the 1970 final's date, and the 1970 semi-final as a WALKOVER — RSSSF prints 'w/o' ('Homenetmen withdrew'), Wikipedia 'scratched … refused to play Hapoel for political reasons', Wildstat '+:-'; the Games table's 2:0 is therefore a claim, not a played match. The 1970 group games are not repeated here: RSSSF gives only the window ('all matches in Tehran, Apr 1-10, 1970'), not the day, and a row may not assert a date its source does not print. 1967: byes in rounds 1–2 and a walkover semi-final (RSSSF: Indian Railways; Wildstat: Bangkok Bank — the two disagree on WHO, agree it was not played) — no match row. venueSlug stays null (the ground lives in match-venues.json, spec §20); venueHe is the source's own wording, kept for the reader.
